propositions: A new advisory LLM criterion, no-file-impact, must judge whether a ticket declaring file_impact_scope=none actually requires repository-file edits.
The criterion must route deterministically via an applies_at.require_file_impact_scope constraint; non-none scopes (paths, undeclared, missing, None) must not trigger it.
The criterion decision rules depend on three sub-answer fields (assertion_plausible, reason_grounded, repo_file_change_named); contradiction or insufficient findings must not block claim.

The persisted no_file_impact_reason must round-trip through deterministic JSON-escaped structured context into the production Pass-1 LLM request, with missing reasons serialized as explicit empty strings.

Applicability routing, prompt auto-discovery, sub-answer schema, and public explain contracts must be verifiable by observable LLM-boundary and CLI behavior, never by source-text grep or private implementation shape.
